selection: First season/fixture/code in each explicit source stratum; exclude all prior controls. Frozen before collecting official responses.
primary_comparison: Compare both-explicit values, omission differences and invalid values separately. No missing-to-zero coercion.
acceptance: No disagreement may be hidden by aggregate agreement. Conflicting cells stay open; field agreement is not blanket row approval.
limitations: Purposeful coverage sample, not random population estimate; same Opta ancestry, not independent provider validation; no scoring holdout claimed.
